{{family name hatnote|Pol|Pérez|lang=Catalan}}
'''Ferran Pol Pérez''' (born 28 February 1983) is an Andorran former international [[association football|footballer]] who last played as a [[Goalkeeper (association football)|goalkeeper]] for [[UE Santa Coloma]].

==International career==
Pol made his senior international debut on 2 June 2010 in a 1-0 friendly defeat to [[Albania national football team|Albania]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.national-football-teams.com/matches/report/11268/Albania_Andorra.html|title=Albania vs. Andorra (1:0)|website=national-football-teams.com|accessdate=26 January 2019}}</ref>
